_readme: Remnants | Skills and Powers server config. Reload with /powers reload. See the docs folder on GitHub for every option.

rpg_player_skills._help: Integration with Remnants | RPG Player Skills (rpg_attribute_system). mode: auto (replace when installed), replace (skill points come from RPG levels), add (RPG levels add points on top of Power levels), off.

tree._help: Set use_custom_tree to true to load skill_tree.json instead of the built-in tree. skill_tree.default.json is rewritten on every start for reference.
